places.name: Alabama
places.note: No Alabama state receipts tax. The business privilege tax (0.025% of paid-in capital x Alabama sales share in loss years) is $0 when it computes to $100 or less, and the $10 annual report fee was repealed in 2024.

places.name: Birmingham
places.note: 0.2% city business license on the Alabama receipts of a Birmingham-located business (out-of-state sales deductible), about $100 minimum. Default share equals Alabama's share of US population.

places.name: Huntsville
places.note: Service-schedule city license of $95 + 0.1% of receipts over $25k (the miscellaneous schedule may instead measure in-city operating cost if greater).

places.name: Jefferson County
places.note: 0.025% county business license on in-county business receipts (capped at $15,000) plus $50 minimum and issuance fee; applies on top of Birmingham/Hoover city licenses.

places.name: Mobile
places.note: About 0.3% city business license on the Alabama receipts of a Mobile-located business (computer programming rate 0.2998%), with a $120 minimum plus $18 of fees.

places.name: Montgomery
places.note: Graduated city license of about $120 plus 0.237% of Alabama receipts (the $100k-$500k bracket rate; marginal rates fall to 0.143% above $2M).

places.name: Tuscaloosa
places.note: Professional-services city license: flat $75-$550 up to $300k of receipts, then 0.2% above that.

places.name: Alaska
places.note: No Alaska tax on receipts; $50/yr state business license plus $200 biennial foreign-corporation tax ($100/yr).

places.name: Fairbanks
places.note: $50/yr City of Fairbanks business license if you sell to Fairbanks customers; fee rises in tiers only above $50k of in-city receipts.

places.name: Arizona
places.note: $50 minimum corporate income tax plus $45 annual report; no receipts tax on services, and TPT on SaaS is assumed passed through to customers.

places.name: Chandler
places.note: $45/yr business registration plus a $2/yr TPT city license if selling SaaS in Arizona; the 1.5% city TPT on SaaS is passed through.

places.name: Mesa
places.note: $25/yr general business license plus a $20/yr TPT city license renewal if selling SaaS in Arizona; the 2.0% city TPT on SaaS is passed through.

places.name: Phoenix
places.note: No Phoenix tax on services receipts and no general business license; a $50/yr TPT city license renewal is assumed (needed only if selling SaaS to Arizona customers), and the 2.8% city TPT on SaaS is passed through.

places.name: Scottsdale
places.note: $50/yr city business registration (or TPT city license); the 1.7% city TPT on SaaS is passed through.

places.name: Tempe
places.note: $25/yr general business license plus a $50/yr TPT city license renewal if selling SaaS in Arizona; the 1.8% city TPT on SaaS is passed through.

places.name: Tucson
places.note: $50/yr city business license plus a $20/yr TPT city license renewal if selling SaaS in Arizona; the 2.6% city TPT on SaaS is passed through.

places.name: Arkansas
places.note: No Arkansas tax on revenue; $150 minimum annual franchise tax (0.3% of apportioned par-value stock, which is below $150 for typical low-par startup stock).

places.name: Little Rock
places.note: No receipts tax in Little Rock; $470 base business license (data-processing class, 2026) if you operate there, plus about $40-55 per programmer or sales employee; base rises to $484 in 2027.

places.name: California
places.note: $800 minimum franchise tax (waived in the first taxable year) plus a $25 annual Statement of Information; California has no state gross receipts tax.

places.name: Berkeley
places.note: 0.36% of gross receipts (professional class; SaaS may instead be 0.18% business-services class) with $51 minimum plus $4 state fee.

places.name: Culver City
places.note: 0.30% (software development) on the greater of gross receipts or total operating costs, after a $200k exclusion, so pre-profit firms pay about 0.3% of their spend.

places.name: Los Angeles
places.note: 0.425% of receipts from work performed in LA (about all receipts for an LA-based team); nothing owed if worldwide receipts are $100k or less and the renewal is filed on time.

places.name: Oakland
places.note: 0.36% of total gross receipts for an Oakland-based business (rising to 0.425% above $1M and 0.475% above $2.5M), plus $60 minimum tax and $4 state fee; no small-business exemption.

places.name: San Diego
places.note: $34 business tax certificate (12 or fewer employees) plus $4 state fee; no receipts-based tax.

places.name: San Francisco
places.note: About 1.25% of SF-apportioned receipts (1.0% up to $2.5M, 1.5% from $2.5M to $25M), owed only once SF receipts exceed $5M; for an SF-based team SF receipts are about 25% of total revenue plus 75% of SF customer sales; $59 registration fee.

places.name: San Jose
places.note: Employee-based business tax: $222.89 base plus $37.98 per employee beyond 2 (10 employees assumed), plus $4 state fee; no receipts tax.

places.name: Santa Monica
places.note: 0.30% of Santa Monica receipts above $60k for software, IT and AI services ($75 minimum); exempt if worldwide receipts are under $103k; about $49 in state and processing fees.

places.name: Colorado
places.note: No Colorado gross receipts or franchise tax; $25 annual periodic report; 4.4% corporate income tax only once profitable.

places.name: Aurora
places.note: No Aurora receipts or head tax (OPT repealed 2025); $28 two-year business license (~$14/yr).

places.name: Denver
places.note: No Denver receipts tax; ~$25/yr sales tax license because Denver taxes SaaS; OPT head tax ($4/employee/month employer share) belongs in payroll expenses.

places.name: Connecticut
places.note: No receipts tax; $250 minimum corporation business tax plus $435 foreign-corporation annual report. A CT-headquartered company may instead owe capital base tax of 0.16% of book equity in 2026 and 0.11% in 2027, falling to the $250 minimum from 2028.

places.name: Delaware
places.note: Every Delaware corporation pays the $400 franchise tax minimum (assumed par value method) plus the $50 annual report. If you operate in Delaware, 0.3983% of Delaware receipts above $100k/month is also owed (plus a $75 license); set the share near 100% if you're based there.

places.name: Dover
places.note: $128/yr Dover business license (computer-related services); no receipts tax.

places.name: Newark
places.note: About $168/yr Newark business license for a professional/administrative office with 5 or fewer employees ($218 with 6-10); no receipts tax.

places.name: Wilmington
places.note: $200/yr city business license (computer services; $500 if also licensed as consultants); no receipts tax. The $15/employee/month head tax over 5 employees and the 1.25% wage tax belong in payroll.

places.name: Florida
places.note: No Florida receipts or franchise tax; $150 annual report fee; 5.5% corporate income tax only once profitable (first $50k exempt).

places.name: Jacksonville
places.note: No receipts tax; if you have an office in Jacksonville, about $659/yr in city + county business tax under the 'data processing' class at 6-10 employees (about $110 if classed as a general service business).

places.name: Miami
places.note: No receipts tax; if you have an office in Miami, about $207/yr in flat fees (city computer-services BTR $99 + Certificate of Use renewal $63 + Miami-Dade County business tax $45).

places.name: Orlando
places.note: No receipts tax; if you have an office in Orlando, about $266/yr in flat fees (city data-processing BTR $220.51 at 6-15 workers in under 2,000 sq ft + $15 Certificate of Use + Orange County $30).

places.name: Tampa
places.note: No receipts tax; if you have an office in Tampa, about $459/yr in flat business taxes (city software-development class $231.52 + $17.35/worker at 10 workers, plus Hillsborough County $54).

places.name: Georgia
places.note: No Georgia gross receipts tax; $60 annual registration, plus net worth tax that is $0 at or below $100k of Georgia-apportioned net worth (up to $5,000 cap).

places.name: Alpharetta
places.note: Office in Alpharetta: no receipts tax; $75 admin fee + $200 base for 5-10 employees ($125 for 1-4); the $10 per employee is counted in expenses.

places.name: Atlanta
places.note: Office in Atlanta: $1.88 per $1,000 (2026, class 5 software/IT; $2.35 from 2027) on Georgia-customer receipts above $10k, plus $191 admin fee and $50 flat tax; $25 per employee beyond the first counted in expenses.

places.name: Sandy Springs
places.note: Office in Sandy Springs: 0.185% of Georgia-customer receipts (NAICS 54; 0.16% if NAICS 51) plus $75 admin fee and $50 flat tax; $13 per employee counted in expenses.

places.name: Savannah
places.note: Office in Savannah: about $75 + 0.089% of Georgia-customer receipts (class C bracket table, 2026).

places.name: Hawaii
places.note: Hawaii's 4.5% general excise tax (4% + 0.5% county) is assumed itemized on invoices like sales tax, so it isn't counted; $12.50 annual report.

places.name: Idaho
places.note: No Idaho receipts tax; $20 minimum corporate tax + $10 Permanent Building Fund tax per year; annual report is free.

places.name: Illinois
places.note: No Illinois receipts tax; $75 annual report fee; franchise tax is $0 because the first $10,000 of liability (about $10M of Illinois-allocated paid-in capital) is exempt.

places.name: Chicago
places.note: No Chicago receipts tax; $250/yr Limited Business License ($500 per 2-year term) if you have a Chicago office; the 15% cloud lease tax is collected from Chicago customers (pass-through), but it also applies to your own cloud/SaaS spend.

places.name: Indiana
places.note: No Indiana tax on receipts; only the $31 biennial business entity report (about $15.50/yr); the 4.9% corporate income tax is $0 before profit.

places.name: Iowa
places.note: No Iowa receipts or minimum tax; a corporation registered in Iowa pays a $60 biennial report every even year (about $30/yr).

places.name: Kansas
places.note: Kansas has no receipts or franchise tax; the only fixed cost is the $90 biennial information report filed online, about $45/yr.

places.name: Kansas City
places.note: KCK has no receipts or earnings tax; a software company with an office or staff in KCK pays a flat occupation tax of about $188/yr (2025, CPI-indexed, about $193 in 2026).

places.name: Kentucky
places.note: Kentucky: $175 LLET minimum plus $15 annual report; 0.095% of Kentucky-sourced receipts once total receipts reach $6M (the $3M–$6M phase-in leaves a nationally-selling company at the $175 minimum); above $6M this overstates by up to $175 because the minimum is really a floor.

places.name: Covington
places.note: Covington: $100 minimum net-profits license fee if you operate there; the 2.5% net-profits rate is zero before profit.

places.name: Florence
places.note: Florence: 0.1% of receipts apportioned to Florence (assumes the team works there), $40 minimum, capped at $10,000 a year.

places.name: Lexington
places.note: Lexington: $100 minimum occupational license fee if you operate in Fayette County; the 2.25% net-profits fee is zero before profit.

places.name: Owensboro
places.note: Owensboro: $75 minimum occupational license fee if you operate there; 1.78% of net profit is zero before profit.

places.name: Paducah
places.note: Paducah: 0.30% of receipts apportioned by where the work is done (assumes the whole team is in Paducah; zero if no one works there), with a $50 minimum shown as an add-on; the rate drops to 0.005% above $5.13M (2026).

places.name: Louisiana
places.note: $35 Louisiana annual report for a foreign corporation (from Oct 1, 2026); corporation franchise tax repealed from 2026; no state receipts tax.

places.name: Baton Rouge
places.note: Only with a Baton Rouge office: occupational license tax of about 0.12% of all receipts (no out-of-state deduction assumed), $50 minimum, $6,200 cap (the cap is not modeled, so this overstates above $5.5M).

places.name: New Orleans
places.note: Only with a New Orleans office: occupational license tax of about 0.12% of receipts delivered in Louisiana (out-of-state sales deductible), $50 minimum, $6,200 cap.

places.name: Maine
places.note: Maine has no gross receipts or minimum franchise tax; a corporation registered there pays a $150/yr foreign-corporation annual report fee.

places.name: Maryland
places.note: No Maryland receipts tax; $300/yr annual report fee as a foreign stock corporation; 8.25% income tax only once profitable.

places.name: Massachusetts
places.note: No MA receipts tax; $456 minimum corporate excise (more if 0.26% of net worth times MA's share of sales is larger) plus $100 annual report.

places.name: Michigan
places.note: No receipts tax in Michigan; $25 annual report fee. The 6% income tax is zero before profit and isn't filed below $350k of Michigan receipts.

places.name: Minnesota
places.note: No receipts tax; $135 foreign-corp annual renewal plus the $260 minimum fee (2026), which applies once Minnesota payroll + property (rent x 8) + Minnesota sales reach $1.28M ($0 below that, $770 above $2.56M).

places.name: Mississippi
places.note: No Mississippi receipts tax; $25 minimum franchise tax (phased out, repealed from 2028) plus $25 foreign-corporation annual report.

places.name: Missouri
places.note: Missouri has no receipts or franchise tax (franchise tax repealed from 2016); a foreign corporation pays a $20 online annual registration report.

places.name: Columbia
places.note: 0.025% of gross receipts (minimum $75, maximum $10,000) Columbia business license; assumes your office is in Columbia.

places.name: Independence
places.note: $75 plus 0.031% of gross receipts over $25k (maximum $50,000) Independence business license; assumes your office is in Independence.

places.name: Kansas City
places.note: About 0.085% of gross receipts plus $25 (Kansas City business license, Table A tiers); assumes your office is in KC and all receipts count, though the city may apportion out-of-state receipts on request.

places.name: Lee's Summit
places.note: $55 flat Lee's Summit business license.

places.name: Springfield
places.note: About 0.025% of gross receipts plus $55 (standard-scale business license, $25 minimum), assuming Springfield treats a software company as a 'service agency'.

places.name: St. Louis
places.note: $675/yr Graduated Business License assuming 6–10 employees working in the City ($200 for 0–2, $1,500 for 11–20); no receipts tax on services.

places.name: Montana
places.note: Montana: $50 minimum corporate income tax (owed even at a loss); no receipts tax; the $20 annual report fee is waived for on-time filings in 2026 and 2027.

places.name: Billings
places.note: Billings: $55/yr business license plus $6 per full-time employee over 5, only if you have an office or staff there; no receipts tax.

places.name: Missoula
places.note: Missoula: business license renewal of $28 per FTE (4-FTE minimum, about $119/yr with the 5% tech fee), only if you operate there; no receipts tax.

places.name: Nebraska
places.note: No receipts tax in Nebraska; a $52 occupation tax every two years (about $26/yr) as a foreign corporation with under $10k of property there.

places.name: Nevada
places.note: Nevada: $650/yr ($150 annual list + $500 state business license), plus a 0.253% Commerce Tax only once Nevada-sourced revenue tops $4M a year; the real tax is on the excess over $4M only.

places.name: Clark County (unincorporated)
places.note: Unincorporated Clark County license: about 0.056% of your office's total revenue, $50/yr minimum; only if your office is outside city limits (e.g. on the Strip).

places.name: Henderson
places.note: Henderson city license: about 0.056% of your Henderson office's total revenue, $50/yr minimum; only if you have an office in Henderson.

places.name: Las Vegas
places.note: Las Vegas city license: about 0.056% of your Las Vegas office's total revenue (not market-sourced), $110/yr minimum; only if you have an office inside city limits.

places.name: North Las Vegas
places.note: North Las Vegas license: about 0.056% of your North Las Vegas office's total revenue, $50/yr minimum; only if you have an office there.

places.name: Reno
places.note: Reno city license: $70/yr, plus 0.085% of Reno gross receipts over $100k (0.065% over $5M); assumes all revenue of a Reno-based office counts.

places.name: Sparks
places.note: Sparks city license: $84/yr, plus 0.1% of Sparks gross receipts over $10k; assumes all revenue of a Sparks-based office counts.

places.name: New Hampshire
places.note: No receipts tax in New Hampshire; $100/yr annual report as a registered foreign corporation; the 0.55% Business Enterprise Tax falls on NH-based payroll (about $825/yr per $150k NH salary), so count it with expenses.
sources: https://www.revenue.nh.gov/resource-center/frequently-asked-questions/business-enterprise-tax (403 to direct fetch; content read via search-result excerpts only)
https://www.revenue.nh.gov/resource-center/frequently-asked-questions/business-profits-tax (403 to direct fetch; content read via search-result excerpts only)

places.name: New Jersey
places.note: $500 New Jersey minimum corporation tax (for NJ receipts under $100k; it steps up to $2,000 at $1M+ of NJ receipts) plus the $75 annual report; no receipts tax.

places.name: New Mexico
places.note: $50 franchise tax plus a $25 report every two years; New Mexico's gross receipts tax (4.875% state, about 7.6% to 8.4% in major cities) is assumed itemized on NM invoices like sales tax.

places.name: Albuquerque
places.note: $36.75 city business license if you have premises in Albuquerque; its 7.625% combined gross receipts tax is assumed passed to customers.

places.name: Santa Fe
places.note: $35 city business license plus a $30 annual fire inspection if you have small premises in Santa Fe; its 8.1875% combined gross receipts tax is assumed passed to customers.

places.name: New York
places.note: New York charges no receipts tax, but there's a $25 minimum franchise tax that steps up with NY receipts ($500 at $0.5-1M, $1,500 at $1-5M) plus a $9 biennial statement; a funded company that raised over $1M may instead owe 0.1875% of its NY-apportioned net assets if that's larger.

places.name: New York City
places.note: New York City charges no receipts tax: there's a $25 business corporation tax minimum that steps up with NYC receipts ($1,500 at $1-5M, $3,500 at $5-25M), plus up to $7.50 of state MTA surcharge on the NY minimum.

places.name: North Carolina
places.note: No receipts tax; $200 minimum franchise tax (0.15% of NC-apportioned net worth, max $500 on the first $1M) plus $25 annual report.

places.name: North Dakota
places.note: No receipts or franchise tax in North Dakota; $25/yr foreign-corporation annual report; income tax (1.41% to 4.31%) is zero before profit.

places.name: Ohio
places.note: Ohio CAT is 0.26% of Ohio-sourced receipts above a $6M yearly exclusion (only the excess is taxed); Ohio has no minimum tax, annual report fee, or corporate income tax.

places.name: Oklahoma
places.note: No Oklahoma receipts or franchise tax (franchise tax repealed from 2024); $100/yr foreign-corporation registered agent fee.

places.name: Oregon
places.note: 0.57% Corporate Activity Tax on Oregon-sourced revenue above $1M/yr (the real tax also adds $250 and subtracts 35% of costs, so this is a ceiling), plus a $150 minimum excise tax and a $275 foreign annual report.

places.name: Portland
places.note: No receipts tax; Portland and Multnomah County each charge a $100 minimum business tax even at a loss once total gross receipts reach $75k (city, 2026) / $100k (county), and their 2.6% + 2% net-income taxes start only at profit.

places.name: Pennsylvania
places.note: Pennsylvania has no receipts or minimum tax for a corporation that isn't profitable yet, only the $7 annual report; its 7.49% corporate income tax is zero until profit.

places.name: Allentown
places.note: 0.3% (3 mills) of receipts for a company based in Allentown, plus a $35 business license; interstate apportionment can lower the share.

places.name: Bethlehem
places.note: 0.15% (1.5 mills) of receipts for a company based in Bethlehem, plus a $25 license.

places.name: Harrisburg
places.note: 0.3% (3 mills, city plus school district) of receipts up to $3.3M for a company based in Harrisburg (1 mill above that), plus a $50 license.

places.name: Philadelphia
places.note: 0.1395% (1.395 mills, tax year 2026) of receipts sourced to Philadelphia, which for a software company means its share of customers there; there is no $100k exclusion from 2025.

places.name: Reading
places.note: 0.225% (2.25 mills, city plus school district) of receipts for a company based in Reading, plus a $55 business privilege license.

places.name: Rhode Island
places.note: Rhode Island: $400 minimum business corporation tax plus $50 annual report each year; no receipts tax.

places.name: South Carolina
places.note: No SC receipts tax. Corporate license fee is $15 + 0.1% of paid-in capital apportioned to SC, $25 minimum; an SC-headquartered startup pays about $1,000 per $1M raised.

places.name: Charleston
places.note: Charleston business license: $49 + 0.28% of ALL gross receipts when your office is in the city (Class 4); pure software publishers may get a 0.055% subclass.

places.name: Columbia
places.note: Columbia business license: $75 + 0.12% of ALL gross receipts when your office is in the city (Class 4), with the rate stepping down above $1M.

places.name: Greenville
places.note: Greenville business license: $57 + 0.177% of ALL gross receipts when your office is in the city (Class 4, 2026-27 rates).

places.name: South Dakota
places.note: South Dakota has no corporate income, franchise, or gross receipts tax; a registered foreign corporation pays only the $55 online annual report fee.

places.name: Tennessee
places.note: 0.1875% business tax on Tennessee-delivered service receipts once the TN location's gross sales reach $100k (SaaS license fees exempt since SAP v. Gerregano, 2026, so pure-SaaS revenue may owe nothing), plus the $100 minimum franchise tax and $20 annual report.

places.name: Chattanooga
places.note: Another 0.1875% city business tax on all Tennessee-delivered service receipts if your Tennessee office is in Chattanooga and its gross sales reach $100k; nothing for remote sellers without a Chattanooga location.

places.name: Knoxville
places.note: Another 0.1875% city business tax on all Tennessee-delivered service receipts if your Tennessee office is in Knoxville and its gross sales reach $100k; nothing for remote sellers without a Knoxville location.

places.name: Memphis
places.note: Another 0.1875% city business tax on all Tennessee-delivered service receipts if your Tennessee office is in Memphis and its gross sales reach $100k; nothing for remote sellers without a Memphis location.

places.name: Nashville
places.note: Another 0.1875% city business tax on all Tennessee-delivered service receipts if your Tennessee office is in Nashville and its gross sales reach $100k; nothing for remote sellers without a Nashville location.

places.name: Texas
places.note: 0.331% of Texas-sourced revenue once total revenue tops $2.65M/yr (EZ computation, 2026-27 reports); this is a ceiling, since a company whose payroll exceeds revenue owes $0 via the compensation deduction and computed tax under $1,000 isn't owed.

places.name: Utah
places.note: $100 Utah minimum corporate franchise tax plus $18 annual renewal; Utah has no gross receipts tax.

places.name: Salt Lake City
places.note: $198/yr Salt Lake City business license base fee if you have an office there (plus $29 per employee once you have more than one); no city receipts tax.

places.name: Vermont
places.note: Vermont has no receipts tax: $100 minimum corporate tax (Vermont receipts ≤ $500k; it steps to $500/$2,000/$6,000 above $500k/$1M/$5M) plus a $250 foreign-corporation annual report.

places.name: Virginia
places.note: No state receipts tax; $1,700/yr SCC annual registration fee (cap tier for more than 270,000 authorized shares, typical of VC-backed startups); 6% income tax only after profit.

places.name: Alexandria
places.note: 0.35% BPOL (services; 0.58% if professional) on all receipts attributed to an Alexandria office once they reach $100k; $50 below.

places.name: Arlington County
places.note: 0.36% BPOL on all receipts attributed to an Arlington office once they exceed $100k (flat $30-$50 below); receipts follow the office, not the customers.

places.name: Fairfax County
places.note: 0.19% BPOL (business services; 0.31% for consulting) on all receipts attributed to a Fairfax County office once over $100k; flat $30-$50 below.

places.name: Loudoun County
places.note: 0.17% BPOL (business services; 0.33% if professional) on receipts attributed to a Loudoun office once over $200k; $30 flat below.

places.name: Norfolk
places.note: 0.36% BPOL (business services; 0.58% if professional) on all receipts attributed to a Norfolk office once over $100k; $50 below.

places.name: Richmond
places.note: 0.36% BPOL (business/personal services; 0.58% if professional) on all receipts attributed to a Richmond office once over $500k; $30 flat below.

places.name: Virginia Beach
places.note: 0.36% BPOL (general services; 0.58% if professional) on all receipts attributed to a Virginia Beach office once over $200k; $25-$50 flat below.

places.name: Washington
places.note: 0.471% retailing B&O on SaaS/IT receipts from Washington customers (1.5% on other professional services), with the small-business credit covering roughly the first $140k/yr of WA receipts; $70 annual report.

places.name: Bellevue
places.note: 0.1596% of receipts sourced to Bellevue once they exceed $215k/yr; plus about $1.32/sq ft/yr square-footage tax, shown here for a 1,000 sq ft office ($0 if remote).

places.name: Bellingham
places.note: 0.17% of receipts sourced to Bellingham above $20k/yr (0.44% for non-retail services); the city license is a one-time $40.

places.name: Olympia
places.note: 0.15% of receipts sourced to Olympia once they exceed $500k/yr; $30 city endorsement.

places.name: Redmond
places.note: No city receipts tax; business license is $160 per FTE working in Redmond ($160 minimum).

places.name: Renton
places.note: 0.07% of receipts sourced to Renton once they exceed $500k/yr; $150 business license.

places.name: Seattle
places.note: 0.342% (2026) of revenue from Seattle customers above a $2M/yr deduction; nothing owed at or under $2M; $73 business license.

places.name: Spokane
places.note: No city receipts tax; $131 business license plus $10-$20 per Spokane employee.

places.name: Tacoma
places.note: 0.153% of receipts sourced to Tacoma once company-wide revenue tops $250k/yr; $435 business license, which assumes $250k-$1M revenue and ranges from $190 to $2,000.

places.name: Vancouver
places.note: 0.1% of retail receipts (likely including SaaS) sourced to Vancouver above $50k/yr; $347 business license plus $165 per FTE.

places.name: Washington, DC
places.note: $250 DC minimum franchise tax ($1,000 once DC receipts top $1M) plus $150/yr biennial report and $49.50/yr business license; 0.11% of DC receipts at $5M+ approximates the flat $5,500-$16,500 sports facilities fee.

places.name: West Virginia
places.note: No West Virginia state receipts or franchise tax on software/services; $25 annual report fee to the Secretary of State; 6.5% corporate income tax only once profitable.

places.name: Charleston
places.note: 1% Charleston B&O tax on gross receipts from services rendered in Charleston (more if headquartered there); exempt under $2,500 total gross income; $20/yr business license if you have a location in the city.

places.name: Huntington
places.note: 0.5% Huntington B&O tax on gross receipts from services in Huntington; $20/yr business license.

places.name: Morgantown
places.note: 0.9% Morgantown B&O tax on service receipts from Morgantown, less a small $3.44/quarter credit; $20/yr business license.

places.name: Parkersburg
places.note: 0.9% Parkersburg B&O tax on service receipts from Parkersburg after a $200/quarter tax exemption (about the first $89k/yr of Parkersburg receipts).

places.name: Wheeling
places.note: 0.88% Wheeling B&O tax on service receipts from Wheeling; $15/yr business license.

places.name: Wisconsin
places.note: No Wisconsin receipts tax; $65/yr foreign-corporation annual report, plus $25/yr surcharge only once total receipts reach $4M (not modeled).

places.name: Wyoming
places.note: No Wyoming income or receipts tax; $60 minimum annual report license tax (≤ $300k of Wyoming assets).

places.name: Jackson
places.note: $179/yr Town of Jackson business license (1–10 employees, non-sales-tax-collecting); applies only with a location in the Town.
